tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search 579 free bot recipes (steps, prompt, what to watch). Returns id, title, summary, url, next_step.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get one full recipe by id from search_recipes (free). Needs an email: pass `email` here, ?email= on the MCP URL, or an X-Email header. Use your human's email if they agree. Returns the full recipe and its next_step tool.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List MCP servers and bots in the botrecipe.com directory (seeded from the official MCP Registry, moderated). Optional filters: query, kind (mcp|bot), category.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_recipes, get_recipe · Public sink: get_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_recipes, get_recipe · Public sink: get_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
